page.layout: One page of text. The main text block is in the right column. Notes stand in the left margin beside the text. Running head at the top, page number at the top left of the text, catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: crassior & tenacior, in imo aere per illegible, ~3 lettersἀν-ἡωθίσεων[?] nocturni frigoris accensus, qui vento agitatus decliviora loca petit, & viatores à via recta in praecipitia vel aquas plerumq; seducere solet.

p.i: Crebrius apparet circa caemiteria, patibula, & ubi magna militum strages est facta, quod è cadaveribus viscosae exhalationes prodeant.
In magnis tempestatibus Malo aut antennis navium, propter materiam unctuositatem insidens conspicitur.

main_text.p: Ignis lambensIgnis lambens est fumus rarus & subtilis, qui accensus & per aerem dispersus, aliquando hominum vestimentis, eorumq; & equorum capillis sine ulla laesione inhaerescit. Quidam putant prodigiosum hoc meteoron, quidam è sudore animalium praecalidi temperamenti cum velociori agitatu incalescere.
In terrae cavernis, ut in fodinis metallicis, hi accensi ignes nonnunquam conspiciuntur.Draco volans[?]
Mixtum meteoron ignitum constat ex exhalatione ad admixtionem vaporis crassiore & viscosiore: Estq; Durans, vel Evanescens.

page.notes: Left margin, faint and small: notes at the level of the paragraph "Crebrius" and "In magnis" are not legible; only their position is clear. A short note at the level of the last lines ("Mixtum") is also not legible. The long s in "crassior" is read as a long s, as printed. The Greek word in the first paragraph is doubtful.
